[[File:Sonrisa.png|thumb|250px|Sonrisa]] '''Sonrisa''' (Japanese: '''チサト''' ''Chisato'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP135|Grin to Win!]]''. She lives in [[Bloomingvale]] in [[Johto]] and raises {{p|Sunflora}} to compete in the [[Sunflora Festival]]. Sonrisa's Sunflora sleep happily in her greenhouse, and a homemade irrigation system keeps them watered and happy. Unlike other {{pkmn|Trainer}}s, who used various odd methods of Pokémon raising such as trips to tanning salons or hiring performers to keep them entertained, Sonrisa simply provided her Pokémon with fresh air, water, and sunshine. She is a kindhearted, easygoing individual who is well-liked in the Bloomingvale community. Sonrisa stumbled across {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} outside Bloomingvale, and gladly offered them a drink from one of her irrigation pipes before inviting them over to her home. Sonrisa often laughed at {{an|Brock}}'s flirtatious comments, not taking them too seriously. She was grateful for Ash and his friends' support, and credited them for helping her win the Sunflora of the Year award. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Sonrisa's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{missingInfo|1|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sonrisa |pkmn=Sunflora |nick=Sunny |type1=Grass |img=Sonrisa Sunny.png |epnum=EP135 |epname=Grin to Win! |vaen=Rachael Lillis |desc=Sonrisa's {{p|Sunflora}}, [[nickname]]d '''Sunny''', is her prized Sunflora which she used to compete in the [[Sunflora Festival]] held in [[Bloomingvale]]. It was not given a nickname in the Japanese version. Sunny was in depression because Sonrisa's {{OBP|Cyrus|EP135|neighbor}}'s Sunflora, called Gwendela, was [[trade]]d to [[Nurse Joy]]. It first appeared with two of Sonrisa's other Sunflora. While the other two were happy, Sunny was gloomy. {{an|Brock}} and {{AP|Pikachu}} tried to cheer it up by making funny faces but did not succeed and it later fell asleep in the greenhouse. Thanks to {{MTR}}'s translations, Sonrisa, {{Ash}}, and {{ashfr}} visited Nurse Joy and her old friend Gwendela. The two Sunflora were happily reunited, and Sunny then returned to its normal self. The next day in the Sunflora Festival, the best contestants were Sunny, Cyrus's Sunflora, Dorabelle, and Meowth [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|dressed as a Sunflora]]. Meowth's disguise was eventually ruined and [[James]] activated huge mirrors which made Sunny and the other Sunflora's heads grow to enormous proportions and they were immobilized. After a wayward {{m|Thunder Shock}} from Pikachu, Sunny sent {{TRT}} blasting off with a powerful Solar Beam. With a great smile and a dazzling performance, the judges awarded Sonrisa the Sunflora of the Year award. Sunny's only known move is {{m|Solar Beam}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sonrisa |pkmn=Sunflora (×2) |type1=Grass |img=Sonrisa Sunflora.png |cap=Sonrisa's Sunflora |epnum=EP135 |epname=Grin to Win! |vaen=Rachael Lillis |desc=Sonrisa has two other {{p|Sunflora}} that she raises with only fresh air, water, and sunshine, unlike unusual methods used by the other people of Bloomingvale.
